# Stotramani (స్తోత్రమణి)
> A pure, distraction-free digital sanctuary for sacred Telugu & Sanskrit stotrams, Vedic chants, and devotional literature.

## Project Information
- Name: Stotramani (స్తోత్రమణి)
- Official Domain: https://stotramani.app
- Founder & Curator: Sudheendra Sripada
- Primary Language: Telugu (తెలుగు), Sanskrit (संस्कृतम्), English
- Contact: contact@stotramani.app

## Mission & Philosophy
Stotramani is designed to offer a distraction-free, privacy-preserving digital library of sacred devotional hymns (stotrams, ashtakams, sahasranamavalis, suktams, and upanishads). It eliminates commercial clutter, popups, intrusive ads, and third-party trackers, focusing purely on high-legibility sacred recitation and spiritual contemplation.

## Key Features
1. Multi-Script Transliteration: Dynamic real-time script conversion supporting Telugu (తెలుగు), Devanagari (देवनागरी), Kannada (ಕನ್ನಡ), Tamil (தமிழ்), and Roman/IAST.
2. Devotional Typography & Themes: Optimized reading contrast with three handcrafted themes:
   - Midnight Gold (Cinematic obsidian dark mode)
   - Aged-Paper Sepia (Traditional palm-leaf/parchment warmth)
   - Clean Light (High-clarity day mode)
3. Vedic Panchang & Daily Nitya Archana: Real-time astronomical calculations of Tithi, Nakshatra, Yoga, Karana, and Rahu Kalam, along with daily deity guidance.
4. Daily Puja Routine: Personal devotional chanting organizer allowing practitioners to star and sequentially chant daily slokas with localStorage persistence.
5. Offline-First PWA: Progressive Web Application with client-side caching for chanting without an active internet connection.
6. Zero Ads & Data Minimization: Strictly no commercial ads, no selling of user data, and complete respect for user privacy.

## Canonical URL Structure
- Homepage / Sacred Library: https://stotramani.app/
- Individual Stotram Reader: https://stotramani.app/readings/{slug}
- Categorized Reader: https://stotramani.app/{category}/{slug}
- Devotional Support & Contact: https://stotramani.app/contact
- Privacy Policy: https://stotramani.app/privacy
- Terms of Service: https://stotramani.app/terms
- Cookie Policy: https://stotramani.app/cookies
- Sitemap: https://stotramani.app/sitemap.xml

## Sacred Deities & Categories Indexed
- Sri Ganesha Stotrams
- Shiva Stotrams & Sri Rudram
- Vishnu Stotrams & Sahasranama
- Sri Rama Stotrams & Keerthanas
- Sri Krishna Stotrams & Gita Govindam
- Sri Venkateshwara Swami Stotrams & Annamayya Keerthanas
- Devi, Durga & Lakshmi Stotrams
- Hanuman Stotrams & Chalisa
- Vedic Chants, Upanishads & Taittiriya Samhita
- Ashtottara Sata Namavali (108 names) & Kavacha Stotrams

## Technical Architecture
- Framework: Next.js (App Router, TypeScript)
- Deployment: Static Site Generation (SSG, output: export) on custom apex domain stotramani.app
- Styling: Zero-dependency CSS custom properties with hardware-accelerated transitions
- Transliteration Engine: Client-side rule-based phonetic Sanscript mapping
